context.body: Noah hears a promise whose named parties and horizon extend far beyond his own life.
context.label: Narrative or literary frame

observations.body: God establishes a covenant with Noah, his sons, their offspring, every living creature, and the earth.
observations.label: The covenant reaches beyond Noah: action

observations.body: The rainbow is named as the sign God will see and remember when clouds gather.
observations.label: The covenant reaches beyond Noah: response

observations.body: covenant · offspring · every living creature · rainbow · remember
observations.label: Words in Genesis 9:8–17

payload.posture: Read Genesis 9:8–17 as blessing and household fracture evidence before carrying it into another source.
payload.tension: The sign is addressed to Noah, but the covenant’s scope cannot be reduced to Noah alone.
payload.title: The covenant reaches beyond Noah
